**In one line**: A "bot-vs-bot" dynamic — where AI bots target other AI systems — is emerging as a new security concern.

### Key points
- Reports highlight automated AI bots increasingly aiming at **other AI agents and systems**, not just human users.
- When both attack and defense are automated, incidents could spread and escalate rapidly with little human oversight.
- As AI agent adoption grows, so does the overall attack surface, analysts note.

### Why it matters
As AI agents move into real workflows, the nature of threats is shifting from "human → system" toward "**AI → AI**." Automated confrontations can scale before humans can intervene, making agent-era security design a pressing new challenge.
